description: This is a unit test class for the DittoDurationValueValidator, which tests validation logic for duration headers in the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies immutability, null handling, valid and invalid durations, and specific edge cases.

classes.name: DittoDurationValueValidatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying validation behavior of DittoDurationValueValidator

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Sets up a valid duration string before any tests run

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the validator instance before each test

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the validator class is immutable

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Tests that passing null as header definition throws NullPointerException

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Tests that passing null as value throws DittoHeaderInvalidException

methods.name: canValidateDittoDuration
methods.description: Verifies that the validator recognizes DittoDuration as a valid type

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequence
methods.description: Ensures a valid duration string is accepted without exceptions

methods.description: Verifies that validation does not throw for strings not specific to DittoDuration

methods.name: acceptNonDittoDurationString
methods.description: Tests rejection of a non-duration string such as 'true'

methods.name: acceptDittoDurationStringWithNegativeAmount
methods.description: Tests rejection of duration strings with negative values

methods.description: Tests rejection of duration strings with unsupported time units like hours
